newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN AUG 9-SEPT 8 TEMPERATURES AVERAGE TO COOL.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN AUG 9-SEPT 8 TEMPERATURES AVERAGE TO COOL.

text.p: Japan is expected to see average temperatures in the southwestern islands and low temperatures in other parts of the country from August 9 to September 8, the Meteorological Agency said on Friday.
Rainfall is expected to be average in the southwestern islands and heavier than the usual year in other parts of the country.

During the next month, sunshine hours in northern Japan and the southwestern islands are expected to be average and light in other parts of the country, the agency said in its latest monthly weather report.
